subject: Aligning exec coverage and locking demo time with Elara Systems
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning exec coverage and locking demo time with Elara Systems

Morning — quick coordination ask. Elara (Tom Hayes + procurement) wants a 45–60 minute live demo the week of Nov 8. They’ve specifically requested CIO presence for the closing Q&A and suggested 11/10 or 11/11 in their initial note.

Two asks:
1) Can Ben (you) cover the technical walkthrough and leave a 15–20 minute handoff to the CIO for the end?
2) Naomi — can you check whether we should route this to VP-sponsor (you or a deputy) instead of the CIO if the CIO availability is constrained? Elara flagged a hard constraint: their CIO can only join between 10:30–12:30 PT on those days.

I’m attaching a draft agenda and an attendee matrix (very rough). If we can confirm a preference (11/10 11:00 PT or 11/11 11:15 PT) I’ll push back with two options to their scheduler and request a calendar hold.

Thanks — short and pragmatic here. If the CIO is mandatory and unavailable we should offer a VP-led closing + a brief follow-up 1:1 with the CIO.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: attendee_matrix.csv (text/csv)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning exec coverage and locking demo time with Elara Systems

Got it — I can own the walkthrough and the deep-dive on latency/cost tradeoffs. Two quick things:
- My preferred slot is 11/10 at 11:00 PT (clean ramp-up after my morning deep focus).
- If the CIO must be at the demo for procurement sign-off, I’d rather we schedule 11/11 at 11:15 PT (gives them a little wiggle room).

I’ll prepare the micro-runbook and callouts for the closing so the executive can step in without friction. Camila — if you confirm the time I’ll draft a 3-slide “sponsor slide” that summarizes commercial asks for the CIO.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
[Internal note: will include a short checklist: join link, projected q&a topics, fallback recording plan]

From: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@elara.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Elara Scheduling <scheduling@elara.com>
Cc: Monique Ruiz <m.ruiz@procure.elara.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning exec coverage and locking demo time with Elara Systems

Thanks, Camila. We’re keen to see the end-to-end flow. Availability as follows:
- 11/10: CIO available 10:30–12:30 PT (can join at 11:00)
- 11/11: CIO available 11:00–11:30 PT only (tight)

If 11/10 11:00 PT works for you, please lock it. Procurement (Monique) needs to be on the invite and may ask for a short follow-up to discuss T&Cs. Also: would prefer the executive portion lead with a 5-minute topline on risk/compliance posture (SOC2 + private deployment options).

I can confirm a calendar hold from our side once you send a proposed invite.

Tom Hayes
Director, IT Strategy — Elara Systems
t.hayes@elara.com
[Elara Scheduling: If you’re matching holds, please mark tentative until we get final confirmation.]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@elara.com>, Monique Ruiz <m.ruiz@procure.elara.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning exec coverage and locking demo time with Elara Systems

Perfect — locking 11/10 at 11:00 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and the short sponsor slide Ben is drafting.

Plan we’ll follow:
- 11:00–11:05 — quick intros / objectives (Camila)
- 11:05–11:35 — product walkthrough + live prompt demos (Ben)
- 11:35–11:50 — exec topline: compliance & deployment risk (Naomi or VP-sponsor)
- 11:50–12:00 — procurement Q&A / next steps (Camila + Monique)

Naomi — can you confirm whether you’ll present the compliance topline or if we should route that to one of our VPs? If you’re short, Ben’s sponsor slide + a 5-minute handoff will work and we’ll schedule a 1:1 with the CIO within 48 hours as Tom suggested.

Calendaring notes: invite will be marked tentative (we’ll push final after Tom confirms on his side). Attachments below; I included a reduced-attendee matrix and a candidate sponsor slide (draft).

Thanks all — I’ll add the Google Calendar link once the invite is ready.

—Camila
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
